description: A short link that opens the app on `path` (and after install, on first launch); a computer goes to the web fallback with the same path. Answers the code and URL. Scope: functions:write.

code.description: A custom code (3 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -)

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

title.description: A label for the Links page

name: links.create
title: Create an app link
